family: MOD3 family defined in proof.md: for every integer n>=0 and x in {0,1}^n, f_n(x)=1 iff x_1+...+x_n is congruent to 0 modulo 3 (so f_0=1). The language L={x : the number of ones in x is divisible by 3} is decided by one fixed linear-time algorithm, with NP verifier V(x,w)=1 iff w is empty and the Hamming weight of x is divisible by 3, and witness bound W(n)=0.
theorem: For this one total uniform polynomial-time family (hence in NP with empty witnesses), C_B2(f_n)>=2n-4 for every integer n>=2 in the full Li-Yang B2 model (all 16 binary gates, unrestricted fan-out and depth, constant nodes free, every gate counted), at actual input length n=|x|; consequently liminf C_B2(f_n)/n>=2.
